title: bew-world
label: Jamie Williams

won.source: The fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast: "Your winner and NEW BEW WORLD CHAMPION! JAMIE WIIIIIIIIIILLIAAAAAAAMS!!" — a Northern Lights Elbow finish, billed "the BEW World Title Match" on the fed's own card.

how: Defeated the reigning champion Devastator with a Northern Lights Elbow; the belt's own only documented title change in the held record.

title: bew-world
label: Devastator

won.source: The fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast bills him entering the show: "He is currently active in the BEW and is its current World Heavyweight Champion." No reign-start document survives.

end.source: The fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast: "Your winner and NEW BEW WORLD CHAMPION! JAMIE WIIIIIIIIIILLIAAAAAAAMS!!"

how: Lost the BEW World Title Match to Jamie Williams, billed "the header to the main event" on the fed's own card; the belt's own earliest documented reign in the held record.

title: bew-hardcore
label: Flesh

won.source: The fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast bills him entering the show's own untitled main event: "a seven time Hardcore champion... He is FLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEESH!!" No reign-start document survives.

how: Billed as reigning champion only; the belt is not defended on this card. The belt's own only documented reign in the held record.
note: Flesh loses the untitled main event to Kevin Merrix that same night (see bew-world's own sibling notes on the Merrix/Flesh bout), but no title is named as being at stake in either the broadcast's own introduction or the fed's own card page — this reign is not recorded as ending on this show.
